description: * This GoPro Smart Remote image is for illustration purpose only. Actual image may vary. GoPro Smart Remote Control your GoPro camera remotely from distances of up to 600 feet (180 meter) with this wearable, waterproof remote. Perfect for gear-mounted shots, you can power the camera on/off, adjust settings, start/stop recording and capture photos. When used with HERO4 and Session cameras, you can also access the Settings/Tag button to quickly change settings, or use HiLight Tag to mark key moments while recording for easy playback, editing and sharing. Smart Remote enables control of up to 50 cameras at a time and features 40% increased battery capacity compared to the Wi-Fi Remote. Mountable and waterproof to 33 feet (10 meter). Includes a key ring and wrist strap for wearing the remote or attaching it to your gear. Compatibility -HERO4 Black. -HERO4 Silver. -HERO Session. -HERO3+ (Settings/Tag button not compatible). -HERO3 (Settings/Tag button not compatible). * This GoPro Smart Remote image is for illustration purpose only.
